title: Phi joins the chat models
summary:
Phi joined the chat models, while community additions brought a ComfyUI node and a Chinese-language DeepSeek tutorial into the project lists.

Added Phi-4 Multimodal Instruct as the `phi` chat model. Llama and several other chat models also gained Portkey routing and default prompts.

Added 1038lab’s ComfyUI-Pollinations node to the SDK and libraries lists. It connects ComfyUI to Pollinations for prompt-based image and text generation across multiple models.

Added isinry’s Chinese-language tutorial on giving a DeepSeek chat UI image generation through the Pollinations API to the tutorial list.

highlights.title: Phi joins chat
highlights.text: Use Phi-4 Multimodal Instruct as the `phi` chat model. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=phi).

highlights.title: Pollinations in ComfyUI
highlights.text: Use the community-built ComfyUI-Pollinations node to generate images and text from prompts with multiple models. It’s now listed among the SDKs and libraries.
